{{Quote|Coruscant, capital of the Republic, an entire planet evolved into one city.|[[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]]|<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Coruscant''' (pronounced /'kɔɹəsɑnt/ or, more rarely, /kəˈɹʌskənt/<ref name="TotJ">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>), originally called '''Notron''', also known as the '''Queen of the Core Worlds''', '''The Jewel of the Core Worlds''', or '''Imperial Center''' under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and as '''Yuuzhan'tar''' under the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. It was the ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] and [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and it was generally also believed to be the original birthplace of [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. During most of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]], Coruscant was the most politically important world in the galaxy. At various times, it was the capital of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], and the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]]. In controlling Coruscant, these governments controlled most of the galaxy in the process.

Over the centuries, Coruscant had developed into an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]], with a total of 5,127 levels of city built up from the crust by the time of the Clone Wars. The actual planet-wide metropolis of Coruscant was called [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. Under the Galactic Republic, the names Republic City or the City of Spires were also used to reference the city. It was also called Imperial City under the Galactic Empire, and New Republic City under the New Republic. However, in practice, Galactic City and its other names were sometimes applied to the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], the central government center and ''de facto'' capital of Coruscant.

==Description==
===Overview===
{{Quote|An incandescent organ of life, visibly vibrating with the pulses of billions.|Supreme Chancellor [[Signet Mezzileen]]|<ref name="CatCW" />}}
Coruscant was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Located at the intersection of numerous major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], including the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], the [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]], the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]], and the [[Leisure Corridor]], its [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates were (0,0,0) which effectively made it the center of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|coordinates]] also inspired the planet's military designation, "triple zero"<ref name="CatCW" /> or "Zero Zero Zero,"<ref name="CSWE Zero Zero Zero">{{CSWECite|III|371|Zero Zero Zero}}</ref> though the actual [[Galactic Center|galactic center]] was located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. As the ''de jure'' center of the galaxy, however, Coruscant was generally agreed to be the most important planet throughout most of [[Galactic Timeline|galactic history]], as well as being one of the wealthiest due to its advantageous location.<ref name="CatCW" />

Coruscant served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|Yuuzhan Vong Empire]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the [[Fel Empire]], [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], and the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]]. It also served at various times as the home of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].

===Surface===
{{Quote|Seen from orbit, Imperial Center is a blaze of light and sparkling colors, reminding some spacers of corusca stones, after which this planet was named long ago.|[[Pollux Hax/Legends|Pollux Hax]]|<ref name="TISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
Geologically, the planet was composed of a molten core with a rocky mantle and a [[Silica/Legends|silicate]] rock crust. At its poles were huge ice caps that were popular spots for tourists. The entire surface of Coruscant was covered by sprawling kilometers-high [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]], and boasted a population of over a hundred billion to several trillion, depending on the era. Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an official census noted 1 trillion official permanent residents. The statistics did not include transients, temporary workers, unregistered populace, nor residents of orbital facilities. Because of these omissions, the actual population of Coruscant was estimated to be three times the official record.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="CNI:JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>

[[File:Surfaceorbit.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Coruscant's surface as seen from orbit]]
Coruscant was known to have the tallest buildings in the Galaxy. Coruscanti skyscrapers dwarfed all the original natural features, including mountains, as well as floors of oceans which once covered a large portion of Coruscant's surface. Areas of Galactic City were broken up into 5,127 levels which were then divided into [[megablock]]s, blocks, and subblocks.<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> Coruscant itself was divided into quadrants, which were divided into zones.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Below the skyscrapers was Coruscant's [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]], where sunlight never reached. Artificial lighting illuminated these lower levels and advertisement [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] could be seen everywhere. There were numerous establishments for entertainment, catering to a myriad of alien species. The residents were collectively referred to as [[Twilighter]]s.<ref name="RotS novel" />

Coruscant was once a world mostly covered in oceans.<ref name="ItWoSWEI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> However, all natural bodies of water were drained and stored in vast caverns beneath the city as a result of years of overpopulation. The only body of water visible was the artificial [[Great Western Sea/Legends|Western Sea]], with many artificial islands floating on it, used by tourists on holidays.<ref name="CatCW" />

With no other bodies of water available to feed and water its trillion inhabitants, Coruscant's architects, along with many others from around the galaxy, worked together to build a self-contained eco-system in the massive buildings set all over the planet. Polar cap stations also melted ice and distributed water throughout the planet-wide city through a complex series of pipes.<ref name="CatCW" />

===Neighborhoods===
{{Quote|Not everyone on Coruscant lives in a luxurious temple on the surface.|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="To Catch a Jedi">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref>}}
[[File:CoruscantUW-ST.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Coruscant's Undercity was dangerous and filled with crime.]]
[[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] was divided into quadrants, several thousand in number, with each quadrant further split into sectors.<ref name="CL" /> Each sector was numbered on official maps, but sectors often had nicknames, such as [[Quadrant H-46|Sah'c Town]], also known as sector H-46, named for a prominent family that owned a large portion of its land, or [[The Works/Legends|The Works]], the largest of Coruscant's designated industrial zones.

The Works was once one of the galaxy's major manufacturing areas, where [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts, [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and building materials were heavily produced for centuries, but as construction and industry became more efficient and cheaper off-world, The Works fell into disrepair.<ref name="CL" /> The area gained a reputation as a hub of criminal activity and locals generally stayed away from it.

A similar, but more dangerous area, was the [[Factory District]], which was once the industrial heart of Coruscant until it too lost out to competition from producers in other Core Worlds. By the time of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], it lay in ruins and was almost completely deserted of sentients, because of the [[feral droid]]s that prowled its streets. It was located on the opposite side of the planet, and was much more dangerous than the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]], [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Invisible Sector]], which were infamous in their own right.<ref name="CNI:JT" />

Another area of Coruscant was [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]], an abbreviation of "collective commerce." Many diverse species lived there and worked in manufacturing. A partially enclosed open-air plaza near the Senate building, the [[Column Commons]], was so-called because it housed most of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] and news media corporations.<ref name="CSWE" />

===Environment===
{{Quote|The attitude of most inhabitants is that Coruscant exists for the business of government, not for vacations and sunbathing and sightseeing…|Pollux Hax|<ref name="TISWU" />}}
A series of [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|orbital mirrors]] were set up that reflected the [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|sun's]] warmth and light. Several of these mirrors were destroyed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], specifically the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. It is known that thunderstorms and rain occurred during [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="TF">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>

[[File:CoruscantPipelines-LT.png|thumb|left|250px|Huge pipelines carry water and other substances across the massive cityscape that covered the surface of the planet]]
The planet produced trillions of tons of waste every hour. Though almost everything on the planet, from clothes to packaging and machinery was recyclable, some waste was too dangerous to recycle. Such items included worn-out hyperdrive cores which were delivered to one of the planet's five thousand garbage pits, where they were put into canisters and fired into a tight orbit around the planet. Garbage ships then collected them and transported them to nearby moons for storage. Some of the more dangerous materials were shot into the nearby sun for complete incineration. Garbage not exported or destroyed was mixed into a slurry of silicone oils and processed by garbage worms which chewed it into pellets while removing any remaining organics, plastic, or recoverable metals. They turned millions of tons of pellets into carbon dioxide, methane, and other gases.

Coruscant's enormous population and industrialization also produced massive amounts of [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]] and heat energy. Thousands of carbon dioxide-reactive [[atmospheric dampener]]s were put into place in the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to prevent atmospheric degeneration. The first set of these planet-wide dampeners, developed by the Galactic Republic, was known as the [[Pasarian Memorial Atmospheric Reclamation Complex Project|Coruscant Atmospheric Reclamation Project]].<ref name="RS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

Near the planet's core were a number of massive [[Power relay/Legends|power relay stations]]. The lowest levels were abandoned to [[mutant]]s and scavengers, such as the cannibalistic, mythical [[Cthon/Legends|Cthon]]. The foundations of many of the transparisteel and smoked duracrete buildings, some of which weighed billions of tons, also extended deep into the planet's crust.<ref name="CSWE" />

[[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|Galactic Standard Time]] was developed on Coruscant and so was tied to the daily and yearly cycle of the planet. A standard day, like Coruscant, was made up of 24 hours, while a standard year's 368 days reflected the length of Coruscant's year.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
===Pre-Republic===
{{Quote|The recorded history of Coruscant stretches back so far that it becomes indistinguishable from legend…|[[Pollux Hax/Legends|Pollux Hax]]|<ref name="TISWU" />}}
[[File:Last_Stand_of_the_Taungs.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Taungs battle the Zhell.]]
Around [[200,000 BBY]],<ref name="Author's Cut 2" /> the planet Notron was home to two [[Species/Legends|species]]: the grey-skinned [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] and the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]],<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the ancestors of the modern [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> The Thirteen Nations of Zhell eventually came into conflict with the Taung, and the [[Battalions of Zhell]] fought the Taung in a fierce [[Zhell–Taung war|war]]. However, during a [[Destruction of Zhell|battle]] at the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Great Zhell]], a volcano erupted, and the Taung overran the terrified Zhell in the battle that followed. Taking the victory and the cloud of volcanic ash as a sign of divine favor, the Taung adopted the name ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]''—the Warriors of Shadow. However, they were ultimately driven off of Notron to the planet [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] by the Zhell.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The leaders of the Thirteen Nations were believed by archaeologists to have been buried near the planet's south pole, in the structure that became known as the [[Ice Crypts]].<ref name="CatCW" /> The [[God/Legends|Mother Goddess]] [[Onrai]] was believed to be the Mistress of the planet Notron.<ref name="SW84">[[Star Wars (1977) 84|''Star Wars'' (1977) 84]]</ref>

Sometime around [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]], the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] species visited Notron—known by that time as Coruscant—though they dismissed the world as primitive and a disappointment.<ref name="TEA" /> Coruscant's Human natives began to urbanize their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] after the departure of the Taung,<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologists]] later believed that the [[Petrax Historic Quarter]] was the site of the planet's first skyscrapers.<ref name="CatCW" /> The [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] species also had contact with early Humans, building Coruscant's original infrastructure,<ref name="Gree">{{TORcite|type=general|Gree: Hydrosupply Leak|Coruscant}}</ref> and by the approximate date of [[90,000 BBY]], the ecumenopolis later known as Galactic City had begun to build upwards.<ref name="TEA" /> As the Human population soared, they were forced to develop the first atmospheric scrubbers, delivery pipelines, recycling plants, and hydroponic farms, and instead of burying unrecyclable garbage, Coruscant's inhabitants built cannons that launched canisters of waste into orbit where garbage scows could tow them out of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="CatCW" />

Around [[30,000 BBY]], the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species discovered Coruscant and incorporated it into their [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. Some Humans were taken as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and put to work across the Empire, though the remaining Humans learned from their rulers' technology and developed [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]]. Over the next several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] dispatched a number of sleeper ships, and by [[27,500 BBY]], their ships had established colonies on [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], [[Axum]], [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]], [[Corfai]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and the worlds of the [[Ringali Shell]] region. Around [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]], they launched ships even further, seeding the planets [[Barseg]] and [[Janilis VII]] in the distant [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="TEA" />

Around [[25,200 BBY]], the Infinite Empire collapsed due to infighting and a species-wide plague that afflicted the Rakata, and the Humans of Coruscant reclaimed rulership of their world.<ref name="TEA" /> Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], they launched the sleeper ship ''[[Lokani Dawn]]''. By [[25,053 BBY]], Coruscant had established contact with Alderaan, [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], Corellia, and many other planets in the Core Worlds, and the planet was the site of the signing of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]], which founded the Galactic Republic and named Coruscant the capital of the new government.<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===Capital of the Republic===
====The Republic's early years====
Almost two centuries after the ''Lokani Dawn''{{'s}} launch, the people of Coruscant were dismayed to witness the vessel's destruction when the sleeper ship—which had been carefully watched by Coruscanti [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] for the last two centuries—was ripped apart by a meteor shower. The development of [[hyperspace cannon]]s linked Coruscant to Alderaan, Duro, Corellia, and other worlds,<ref name="TORE" /> but it was not until [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] scientists succeeded in reverse-engineering the [[Force-drive|Rakatan hyperdrive]] around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] that starships could travel between the worlds of the Republic in a matter of days. Coruscant soon became the anchor for the newly charted Perlemian Trade Route, a major hyperlane that linked the Republic with the distant Tion Cluster—where the Human colonists had developed their own proud and warlike society.<ref name="TNEC" /> Coruscant also sat at the intersection of the Perlemian and the [[The Spin|Spin]], a hyperlane that wrapped around the Deep Core from Metellos to Corellia.<ref name="TEGtW" /> 

As diplomatic and economic connections expanded, Coruscant was selected as the center of a unified diplomatic government, the Galactic Republic. The Republic’s membership expanded as explorers discovered new worlds and cultures, increasing Coruscant’s political and economic importance. Trillions settled on the planet to trade, learn, and live at the center of the galaxy.<ref name="TORE" />

[[File:Coruscant_TEA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Coruscant, the capital of the Galactic Republic]]
Around 25,000 BBY, the Perlemian Trade Route brought the Republic into contact with the Jedi Order on the distant planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], and after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Haune Tiar]] toured the Republic, the Jedi became the government's protectors and established a presence on Coruscant.<ref name="GH12">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 12: The Birth of the Republic}}</ref> However, when the [[First Great Schism]] split the Jedi Order around [[24,500 BBY]], Coruscant was caught up in the conflict between the Jedi Order and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] of the [[Legions of Lettow]], as a [[Battle of Coruscant (First Great Schism)|battle]] occurred on Coruscant during the fighting.<ref name="TEGtW" /> Around [[24,000 BBY]], the [[Tionese War]] broke out with the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]] as the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] began a march of conquest along the Perlemian Trade Route. Between 24,000 and [[23,900 BBY]], the Tionese pushed deep into the Core Worlds, and even Coruscant itself was [[Battle of Coruscant (Tionese War)|attacked]]—the Tionese [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] Coruscant's city-surface with [[pressure bomb]]s.<ref name="TEGtW" /> As the centuries passed, Republic City—a district in Coruscant's eastern hemisphere near the Manarai Mountains—expanded outward, absorbing the planet's other districts and developing into the ecumenopolis of Galactic City.<ref name="CatCW" />

As Coruscant grew more prosperous, the Core World of Alsakan began to grow jealous of the planet's place at the heart of the Republic. Alsakan was a major influence in the Human-dominated sectors along the Perlemian Trade Route, primarily the region known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]], while Coruscant was a powerful player in the [[Arrowhead]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]—the sections of the Core Worlds, the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that lay between the Perlemian to the north and the Spin to the south. The Spin was the original lifeline of the Republic, and because the Perlemian only intersected with the Spin at Coruscant, Alsakan and its dependents were largely independent from the rest of the Republic. The aristocratic Alsakani, who called the Perlemian the Axis, sought to supplant Coruscant as the seat of Republic power, and in [[17,018 BBY]], Alsakan led the Axis worlds in claiming a number of resource-rich systems to block the [[Grand Companies]], the major trading conglomerates of the Spin. Coruscant and the Republic backed the Spin merchants, sending a fleet to the planet [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] and [[Republic assault on Virujansi|capturing it]]. Thus began the [[First Alsakan Conflict]], a [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of seventeen wars between the Coruscant-dominated Republic and Alsakan that spanned fourteen thousand years. The First Conflict was ended by the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] in [[16,700 BBY]], though both Coruscant and Alsakan would be raided during the early conflicts, neither side ever achieved true victory over the other, and Corellia developed into a third galactic player as it excused itself from the conflicts.<ref name="TEGtW" />

In [[15,500 BBY]], Republic scouts encountered the enormous, fire-breathing reptilian species known as the [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] on a [[Duinuogwuin homeworld|planet]] in the Outer Rim Territories. Terrified, the scouts opened fire on the Duinuogwuin and fled the planet, returning to Coruscant, but the enraged Duinuogwuin followed their attackers back to the capital and [[Attack on Coruscant|attacked]] it in what would be later known as the [[Duinuogwuin Contention]]. The [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] at the time, [[Fillorean]], refused to mobilize the Republic Navy and instead attempted to communicate with the massive Star Dragons attacking the planet—and to the surprise of the terrified Coruscanti, Fillorean was successful. The Duinuogwuin were actually intelligent and naturally peaceful, and the Duinuogwuin philosopher [[Borz'Mat'oh]] negotiated a treaty to end the conflict. The two later worked together to establish the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]], the planet's first university,<ref name="GH17">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 17: The Duinuogwuin Contention}}</ref> and the two were immortalized in a pair of statues fashioned from [[Chalcedony/Legends|chalcedony]].<ref name="CatCW" />

====The Pius Dea and onward====
[[File:Coruscant_TOR_New.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Coruscant as it appeared thousands of years before the Galactic Civil War]]
Around [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] was established on Coruscant, and it would serve as the galaxy's premier repository of historical artifacts for well over ten thousand years.<ref name="CatCW" /> By that time, a religious cult known as Pius Dea that worshiped a deity named [[The Goddess]] had been established on Coruscant for several centuries, and the cult's followers were known for their strict moral code and their emphasis on both spiritual purity and [[humanocentrism]]. Around 12,000 BBY, the Human later known as [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]] rose to prominence within the [[Coruscant Merchants' Guild]], and he became a leadership figure in the [[Pius Dea]] faith on Coruscant. Pius Dea arranged for the impeachment of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Supreme Chancellor [[Pers'lya]] in [[11,987 BBY]], and his [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] shortly afterward, and Contispex I was elected to succeed Pers'lya as a result.<ref name="TEGtW" />

Under Contispex, the Pius Dea became the unofficial religion of the Republic, and he taught that communities could be restored to purity by purging "irredeemable" elements—and to the Pius Dea, [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species were the epitome of spiritual corruption. In [[11,965 BBY]], Contispex I launched the [[First Pius Dea Crusade]], one of thirty-four military campaigns against alien species that would be conducted by Contispex and his successors, who formed the [[Contispex dynasty]] and took on the title of Contispex to honor the first Contispex. In [[11,933 BBY]], the Jedi Order departed Coruscant and returned to Ossus in the [[Recusal]], as they could not decide what action to take against the corrupt Republic. The [[Pius Dea Era]] finally ended in [[10,966 BBY]], when the Jedi Order, Alsakan, and a number of alien species defeated the Pius Dea at the [[Battle of Uquine]] in the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

====Wars with the Sith====
After the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], where the Jedi helped [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Hyperspace War)|repel]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] invaders from Coruscant, the Galactic Senate granted a vast tract of land on Coruscant to the Jedi Order.<ref name="PotJS">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> The Sith had managed to reach the steps of the Senate building before the [[Sith Meditation Sphere|Sith meditation sphere]] coordinating and exaggerating their forces was damaged, allowing the Republic and Jedi to counterattack.<ref name="TFotSE 3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 3]]</ref> The land given to the Jedi, surrounding a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] centered on a [[Sacred spire/Legends|mountain]], had been a place of worship for the Coruscanti for centuries. Many [[Senator/Legends|senators]] expected the Jedi to construct a fortress to defend the planet in the event of a future invasion, but while the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] eagerly accepted the land, it held to the belief that the Jedi were not by nature a military force. Instead, the Council authorized the construction of meditative centers and [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] centers, some of which helped preserve Coruscant's disappearing natural environment.<ref name="PotJS" /> Following the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|devastation of Ossus]], the Jedi Council took up residence in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, to which many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] relics from Ossus were taken. The Temple was greatly expanded, including the building of the original [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|Jedi Council Chamber]].<ref name="CSWE" />

[[File:Sacking_Of_Coruscant_Imperial_Forces.jpg|thumb|left|325px|Sith dreadnoughts over Coruscant.]]
The [[Great Galactic War]] broke out between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[3681 BBY]] and lasted until [[3653 BBY]]. Towards the end of the war, the Sith surprised the galaxy and extended an offer of peace to the Republic. Although cautious of the Empire's intentions, the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] accepted.<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref>

While Republic and Imperial delegations convened on Alderaan for [[Alderaan peace conference|treaty negotiations]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] led a Sith battle fleet to Coruscant and initiated the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. Their first contact was made with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] [[Orbital Security Station Six]] which the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] quickly obliterated. They then began their invasion of the planet. Sending a stolen Republic shuttle to the Jedi Temple, the Sith broke through and engaged the Jedi who were present as well as the [[Temple Security Force]]. However, the Jedi were overwhelmed and Coruscant's defenses were brought down, allowing the Sith to land their troops. The Sith took the Senate Building and the [[Berooken|Supreme Chancellor]] was assassinated. Six members of the Jedi Council were also killed in the battle, while the Jedi Temple itself was destroyed.<ref name="Timeline 1" />

With Coruscant securely in their grip, the Empire was able to take command of the negotiations on Alderaan, forcing the Republic delegation to sign the controversial [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Although it brought an end to the Great Galactic War, the treaty set the stage for the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]],<ref name="Timeline 1" /> which would last a scarce decade before [[Galactic War|open conflict resumed]]. Even then, scars left by the Sith Empire were still visible on the planet, both on its inhabitants and on the buildings.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

At some point before 3600 BBY, the war with the Sith ceased,<ref name="TEGtW" /> and the Jedi returned to Coruscant, erecting a new Temple in place of the old. This new Temple was repeatedly expanded, including in [[3519 BBY]] and [[2500 BBY/Legends|2519 BBY]] when the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] were built, and [[1019 BBY]] when the Temple spires were finally fully rebuilt.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict|seventeenth]] and final Alsakan Conflict also occurred after the conclusion of the Sith wars, and in [[3017 BBY]], Corellian [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] inflicted a dramatic defeat on a Republic squadron at Coruscant. The Republic declared war on Corellia in response, but its forces were quickly outfought, and the conflict ended when Corellian [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Jonash e Solo]] dictated a peace treaty on the floor of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

The [[New Sith Wars]] brought turmoil again to the Republic. Beginning in [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]] with the [[Fourth Great Schism]] and ending in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the New Sith Wars contained 1,000 years of fighting between the Republic and the Sith. The [[Republic Dark Age]] that began in [[1100 BBY/Legends|1100 BBY]] was seen by most as a period where the Republic ceased to exist as its territory became a rump around Coruscant and the some of the Core Worlds. The Jedi took direct control of the Republic, bypassing the Senate entirely. The Sith were poised to take Coruscant itself only to be [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|stopped]] at [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. With the Sith armies thought to be completely destroyed, the Republic was rebuilt under the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. A new age began for the Republic, a time of peace lasting for several centuries.<ref name="CSWE" />

====Great Peace of the Republic====
One [[Attack on Coruscant (pre–Clone Wars)|attack]] on Coruscant took place over 1000 years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> In [[335 BBY]], the Coruscanti government introduced [[Granite slug/Legends|granite slugs]], a species of land mollusks, to the planet's undercity to aid in efforts to clean up refuse that had accumulated over centuries. Over time, the slug population exploded, and while the appearance of the paved areas in the undercity was greatly improved, the slugs also served as a food source for predators that had previously been contained.<ref name="TJAS">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> In [[110 BBY]], many [[Blood Carver]]s relocated from their homeworld of [[Batorine]] to Coruscant, where they became famous for their wood carvings.<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> In later decades, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] of royal blood, used his fortune as the head of [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]] to raze Coruscant's historic [[Farfalla skyscraper]] and construct a [[Xizor's Palace|castle]] in its place from the sub-foundations up.<ref name="CatCW" />

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], terrorist organization [[The Flail]], accusing the Galactic Senate of corruption, disrupted public services of Coruscant, including commerce, communications, traffic, and weather, destroying property and lives while doing so. They were stopped by agents of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="SoC">{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}}</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the violent criminal gang [[Black Heth]] started terrorizing the Coruscant Underworld. The [[Jin'ha]] group was supplying weapons, but the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] intervened and stopped the criminal activity.<ref name="OW">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref> Later that year, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] escaped a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] of her homeworld, and on Coruscant her attempts to persuade the Senate to aid Naboo were thwarted by bureaucracy and political maneuvering. In frustration, she called for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in the embattled [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Valorum, paving the way for Naboo senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to take his place.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

[[File:Xiaan-2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Xiaan Amersu]] amidst the aftermath of [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] killings]]
In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Peerce]] and [[J'Mikel]] were killed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], who was wanted for the murder of several other Jedi, while searching for her on Coruscant. [[Xiaan Amersu]], J'Mikel's Padawan, reported the incident to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] at the Jedi Temple, where a mission to capture Sing was organized.<ref name="SW28">[[Star Wars (1998) 28|''Star Wars'' (1998) 28]]</ref>

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Coruscant was almost destroyed by [[Ashaar Khorda]] using the [[Infant of Shaa]]. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], and [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] saved Coruscant, although Poof [[Skirmish at Coruscant's power core|sacrificed]] himself to do so. News of this averted disaster was never widely divulged, however.<ref name="DB PY">{{DB|character|yaraelpoof|Poof, Yarael}}</ref> In the same year, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] and his Padawan, [[Lorana Jinzler]], interrupted a meeting between Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and his aide, [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], on Coruscant to demand more funding for C'baoth's proposed [[Outbound Flight Project]]. The sides came to an agreement that if C'baoth could resolve a mining strike on the planet [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]], it would free up enough funds to finish the project, after which Palpatine ordered Doriana to keep watch over C'boath. Doriana returned to his apartment to pack and contacted his true master, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. After C'baoth received permission from the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to travel to Barlok, Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] ordered Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to follow C'baoth to his destination.<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

====Separatist Crisis====
{{Quote|The port crowding has reached dangerous levels. We can no longer assure the safety of newcomers to this world, or to the citizenry residing adjacent to the ports. In the interests of security, these new measures are needed.|Minister Zelebitha Effhod explains new security measures|<ref name="HNNtraffic">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_1.html|Coruscant Restricts Immigration}}</ref>}}
[[File:Westport.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An Aqualish family awaits departure from Coruscant during the Separatist Crisis.]]
In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], former Jedi Master [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] reemerged on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and delivered an impassioned speech that presented the case for the Republic's irreversible corruption. Thus began the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], in which thousands of worlds seceded from the Republic and joined Dooku's newly inaugurated [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Westport]], which handled the bulk of Coruscant's emigrant departures, experienced a 6,000% increase in traffic during the crisis, while [[Eastport/Legends|Eastport]] took in masses of refugees from seceded worlds.<ref name="HNNexodus">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_2.html|Mass Aqualish Exodus Expected}}</ref> On [[Great ReSynchronization|13:3:6]], Supreme Chancellor Palpatine announced on the general channels of the HoloNet from the Senate Rotunda that 5:16 would be the date of a full Senate vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|creation]] of a centralized military to oppose the Separatist threat.<ref name="HNNmca">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|news/1337_1.html|Palpatine Sets Army Vote Date}}</ref> On the morning of 13:3:7, a three-hour brawl between [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] and [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] immigrants at the Eastport processing station left 15 dead and 45 wounded.<ref name="HNNbrawl">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|news/1337_4.html|15 Dead in Houk / Weequay Brawl at Eastport}}</ref> On 13:4:4, a garbage launcher misfire destroyed four surrounding blocks of the cityscape and littered the entire [[Desrini District]] with dangerous industrial waste,<ref name="HNNgarbage">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_2.html|Garbage Launcher Misfire Kills 48; Closes Desrini}}</ref> which attracted huge numbers of scavenging [[Dianoga/Legends|dianogas]] to the area over the following months.<ref name="HNNdianogas">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|news/1359_3.html|Desrini Plagued by Dianogas}}</ref> Later in 13:4, the [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]], in response to port overcrowding and the threat of Separatist [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]], issued new restrictions on all interstellar traffic inbound to Coruscant.<ref name="HNNtraffic" />

Meanwhile, the Military Creation Act spawned increasingly vocal advocates and opponents, and on 13:5:9, large-scale riots were narrowly averted when the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] was dispatched to disperse crowds gathering at the entrances of the Senate Rotunda.<ref name="HNNprotests">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|news/1359_1.html|Anti-War Rally Dispersed by Senate Guard}}</ref> On 13:5:16,<ref name="TEA" /> an assassination attempt on Naboo senator Padmé Amidala was made when she arrived on Coruscant to vote against the Military Creation Act. A bomb destroyed her starship shortly after its landing, killing several of her handmaidens and guards. Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were assigned to protect her, and during the following night they foiled another attempt at Padmé's penthouse by Zam Wesell, leading to an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] chase which ended in a showdown at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a sports bar and club in an entertainment district in the lower levels of the planet. The Jedi captured Wesell, but she was killed by Jango Fett. Kenobi's subsequent investigation of Wesell's death led him to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], setting off a chain of events that led to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

====Clone Wars====
[[File:SecurityActCoruscant.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Chancellor Palpatine's Security Acts put Coruscant in a perpetual state of lockdown.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Clone Wars erupted when the newly created [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|attacked]] the Confederate-controlled world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="AotC" /> Coruscant experienced a number of radical changes during the galaxy-spanning conflict. Large swaths of the cityscape were laid low to make room for the construction of military staging areas. Millions of citizens were displaced by the urban renewal, most of them impoverished, members of alien species loyal to the Confederacy of Independent Systems, or both. Initially, there was public outcry, but such dissidence was either ignored or quashed. Acts of terrorism were also commonplace, with indiscriminate tactics such as bombings resulting in hundreds, or sometimes thousands, of casualties. Most were the products of Separatist cells, while some isolated incidents were of questionable origin. Assassination attempts on influential Republic politicians were common.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Incidents included the [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|raid]] of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro's]] [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|palace]] after the Republic discovered the Hutt's affiliation with Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]; the holding of Senator [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]] hostage by [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] terrorists which was actually cover for an attempt to turn the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] against the Republic; and the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]] at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] that was carried out by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to free Ziro the Hutt. The year [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] saw a wave of such disasters, including the [[Coruscant Insurrection]] by Count Dooku and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Trenox]] to steal a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] at the Jedi Temple;<ref name="TNDA">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref> the bombing of the freighter ''[[Star of Iskin]]'' that killed former Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum and thousands on the surface as a result of raining debris;<ref name="Republic 61">[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref> a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|terrorist attack on a power generator]] that resulted in power outages and fires throughout the Senate District;<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> the assassination of Senator [[Viento]] by rogue Jedi [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]];<ref name="Republic 63">[[Republic 63|''Republic'' 63]]</ref> and the murders of Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] and Senator [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]] by Farr's personal aide [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]].<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>

[[File:Target_sighted.png|thumb|left|250px|The Zillo Beast terrorizes Coruscant while hunting Chancellor Palpatine.]]
Also, at some point during the Clone Wars, there was an [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|incident]] involving a [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. After the creature was transported to Coruscant by order of Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the Zillo Beast was subjected to examination and experimentation. When Palpatine ordered its destruction in order to hasten the procedure, the Zillo Beast broke free and immediately sought vengeance on the man who was intent on killing it. As it rampaged through Galactic City, thousands of citizens tried to flee in terror while the Jedi and their clone forces scrambled to neutralize the creature. Upon reaching the Executive Building, the Zillo Beast nearly succeeded in killing the Chancellor, only for its efforts to be thwarted by the Jedi. Although they succeeded in killing it, Chancellor Palpatine discreetly ordered that the Zillo Beast be cloned to conduct further research.<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>

Such incidents prompted the Republic to implement numerous changes on Coruscant in the name of increased security. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] of the Republic's newly formed [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] were dispatched throughout the planet on regular patrols as the [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|capital's military guard]]. The fanatically pro-Human [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|COMPOR]] was founded; the local [[SAGroup (COMPOR)/Legends|SAGroup]], led by [[Nenevanth Tion]], marched in a parade of Republic patriotism on Coruscant. COMPOR pressured [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] into deporting from the capital all members of species whose homeworld had joined the Confederacy.<ref name="CSWE" />
Following the ''Star of Iskin'' incident, the Senate approved the [[Enhanced Security and Enforcement Act]], which allowed Supreme Chancellor Palpatine to strip civil liberties in the name of civil security. Coruscant fell under particularly heavy government supervision, with security becoming gradually tighter as one traveled deeper into the levels of the Galactic City.<ref name="Republic 72">[[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]]</ref>

The planet's lower levels, which had once been a haven for crime and an unregulated market, became heavily subdued, such that illicit goods and services became difficult to find.<ref name="Republic 73">[[Republic 73|''Republic'' 73]]</ref> While most [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] were content with surrendering these and other liberties for security, the changes did not sit well with the galactic capital's [[Alien/Legends|alien]] population, particularly those that were associated with the [[Separatist Council/Legends|leadership]] of the Confederacy. Many [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]], [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]], and [[Gossam/Legends|Gossams]] suffered ostracization on Coruscant, while many others were forced to flee the world altogether. In addition, numerous rumors surfaced regarding antiwar demonstrations that were quelled with forceful measures, seizure of private property, and disappearances. As disturbing as these abuses of power were, proof of the acts was either nonexistent or easily discredited. Throughout the remainder of the war, the Enhanced Security and Enforcement Act was altered by amendments known as the Security Acts, which, although intended to further enhance security throughout the Republic, also contributed to Palpatine's growing power over the government and the weakening of the authority of the Galactic Senate.<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

[[File:IronEclipse4-BattleofCoruscantunfolds.png|thumb|right|300px|Coruscant finds itself besieged and attacked by the Separatist Alliance in 19 BBY.]]
Despite the numerous precautions taken, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="RotS novel" /> on 15:5:20,<ref name="TEA" /> the Confederacy of Independent Systems succeeded in making a surprise raid on Coruscant. Bypassing the heavily fortified [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] by use of secret hyperspace routes through the Deep Core provided by Darth Sidious, a Separatist fleet under the command of the dreaded [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] took the city planet completely unaware. While the Separatist ships engaged the Republic home defense fleet, an army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] descended upon Galactic City. The invasion distracted the defending Jedi and clone forces while General Grievous and a squad of his elite [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]] captured Chancellor Palpatine. However, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi succeeded in rescuing the Supreme Chancellor from the infamous Separatist flagship [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. The Battle of Coruscant eventually turned in the Republic's favor, and the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist armada]] was forced into a full retreat. However, the battle had shaken much of the population, and large portions of the city had been decimated by falling ships or collateral damage caused in the vicious fighting.<ref name="RotS novel" />

At the conclusion of the Clone Wars, Chancellor Palpatine brought about the destruction of the Jedi Order by issuing [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to all clone troopers throughout the galaxy from his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|executive office]]. In the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|announced]] the creation of his [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] to the Galactic Senate. With the Jedi all but destroyed, Palpatine proclaimed his intentions to reorganize the Republic into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and thus declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Meanwhile, [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], having witnessed the massacre at the Jedi Temple, [[Infiltration of the Jedi Temple/Legends|transported]] surviving Jedi Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi to Coruscant, where, at the Temple, the two Jedi dismantled a coded signal urging Jedi to gather there. Yoda later [[Skirmish in the Senate|confronted]] Palpatine at the Senate Building, but failed to kill him.<ref name="RotS" />

===Galactic Empire===
====Palpatine's rule====
{{Quote|Imperial Center was a world with enough diversions for just about anyone.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="MJ:BtEH">''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Imperialpalace1.png|thumb|left|200px|The Imperial Palace]]
As with the Republic, Coruscant continued to function as the galactic capital, but was renamed "Imperial Center," while Galactic City was re-dubbed "Imperial City."<ref name="CSWE" /> While the planet's name was officially changed during Palpatine's rule, most working-class denizens of the Galactic Empire continued to call the planet-city by its old name. As part of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] policies of the Empire, non-Human species were also compelled to live in segregated areas of Imperial City, the largest and best-known of which was known as [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Invisec]]. Those who did enter other parts, whether by intention or mistake, were punished brutally.<ref name="CatCW" /> Coruscant was also the site of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]<ref name="SotES" /> until the body's [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Coruscant was seeded with weapon factories, laboratories, and various other military installations. Shipyards were also stationed above the planet to construct capital ships. As a symbol of Imperial power, Coruscant would act as a staging area within orbit of the planet where massive Imperial fleets would gather, to the point where they blocked the sunlight from reaching the planet.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Emperor Palpatine also began to shape Coruscant with his own designs, and this included the installation of almost one million surveillance systems throughout the ecumenopolis. Massive shield generators were placed all over Coruscant, and where the shield segments overlapped, powerful storms would brew. Although Coruscant had always been known for its high concentration of thunderstorms due to rising vapor from the billions of buildings and homes, the increased frequency lent the planet a foreboding, almost Gothic look. Palpatine also arranged for the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' to be buried beneath the [[Manarai Mountains]] district. Later, the massive battleship was used as a private prison by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Palpatine also had the Palace of the Republic rebuilt and renamed the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. The Palace, a massive pyramidal structure which was by far the largest structure on Coruscant, was rumored to also be the largest building in the entire galaxy, with the possible exceptions of the massive [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] plastic pyramids of the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]].<ref name="CatCW" /> Upon the completion of the Palace, Palpatine ordered the construction of a [[Darth Vader's Palace|smaller castle residence]] for [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] nearby. Although Vader already possessed a [[Darth Vader's Coruscant fortress retreat|fortress retreat]] on Coruscant and several other retreats off-world, the castle would function as his main residence.<ref name="SotES" />

[[File:Coruscant_under_Palpy_reign_BoS.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Coruscant under the reign of Palpatine]]
Under Imperial rule, illegal trade flourished on Coruscant, where the nobility coveted certain prohibited items, including [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and banned artwork, as status symbols. Palpatine tolerated such activity, as it kept minor nobles occupied with their own intrigues and provided him with a means of blackmailing some nobles into his service.<ref name="SotES" /> Around this time, the most prominent [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealer on the planet was [[Wendell Wright-Sims]], a wealthy socialite who operated with the express permission of the Emperor himself and took great pains to ensure that his product was the finest available.<ref name="SotES" /> Most members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] considered venturing to Coruscant a foolhardy endeavor; nevertheless, Coruscanti resistance cells did exist, based in the planet's Factory District. [[Shasheva Astopone]], the heiress to an exporting fortune, used her wealth to fund some of the local Rebel cells and smuggled goods to and from Coruscant for the Alliance through her business.<ref name="CatCW" />

Following Palpatine's departure to the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], to oversee the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], at least two, massive [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] commonly known as [[worldcraft]]s were being constructed. The Emperor personally gifted them to his most loyal servants, with [[Ennix Devian]] and Grand Moff [[Ardus Kaine]] were to be gifted a craft each, however, Devian would steal both of them for his [[Restored Empire|new empire]] following the failure at Endor.

====The Empire erodes====
{{Quote|The common perception is that the Alliance's current momentum will carry it to Coruscant, the seat of Imperial power. While all of us would like to believe that such a sweeping victory is imminent, we also know that reality is seldom so convenient.|Voren Na'al, after the Battle of Endor|<ref name="TTBS">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
Following the death of Palpatine at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], an [[Coruscant uprising|uprising]] took place on Coruscant. Billions of Coruscanti reveled in their new-found freedom, and an armed uprising sprang out from the non-human-dominated sectors. Imperial patrols were attacked in the streets, statues of Palpatine were toppled and other Imperial symbols were desecrated.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> In the midst of the celebrating and rioting, alarmed Imperial authorities ordered a massive crackdown on the rebellious elements in the city-planet's population and gave full power to the local military force to end the uprising and restore order to the system. The military retaliation was ruthless and the death toll rose as the Empire struck down the insurrectionists and brought the populace back under its control.<ref name="MJ:BtEH" />

In the six months after Palpatine's death, operatives of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] destroyed several Coruscanti [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] installations key to communication between the capital and Imperial forces throughout the galaxy. With the cessation of leadership from Coruscant and the absence of a clear successor to Palpatine, many [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] and admirals in outlying regions became [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], seizing sectors and fleets for themselves.<ref name="R&R">{{JournalCite|2|Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant}}</ref> One such individual was [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]], who departed from Coruscant with the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']] with the intention of defending his native [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

Amidst these tumultuous events, the [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] assumed control of Imperial Center. Unfortunately, he was opposed by Palpatine's former advisors who formed the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Inner Circle]]. Ysanne Isard operated as a neutral intermediary between the two opposing factions. Unbeknownst to them, she had been secretly pitting them against each other, clearing the path for her rise to become Empress in all but name, though neither side realized her true intentions until it was far too late. She eventually assumed control of Imperial Center in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] though her reign was plagued by the threat of rival warlords and the expanding New Republic. Thus, she had a team of scientists including [[Evir Derricote]] create an artificial virus known as the [[Krytos virus]] which only affected non-Human species and then contaminated the city planet's water supply with it.<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

====New Republic takeover====
[[File:The_Heart_of_the_Empire.jpg|thumb|left|260px|Coruscant remained the heart of the Empire for a time after the fall of Palpatine]]
In [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]], the famous New Republic starfighter squadron [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] under their leader [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was sent undercover to infiltrate Coruscant and sabotage the planet's powerful shield generator. To do this, they hijacked a [[EVS Construction Droid|construction droid]] and used it to transport them to a command center where they used one of the planet's orbital mirrors to evaporate a large amount of reservoir water, thus creating a powerful electrical storm which brought down the shields. This allowed a New Republic fleet under the famed [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] to enter the Coruscant system and [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] the galactic capital<ref name="WG" /> on 42:2:17.<ref name="TEA" />

However, within days of the victory, millions of Coruscant's non-Human population started to die due to the Krytos virus. Since only Humans were immune to the virus, this drove a wedge between the New Republic's member species. Worse, Ysanne Isard used the ''Lusankya'' to escape Coruscant and flee to the planet [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] despite the efforts of Rogue Squadron. In the process, the ''Lusankya'' caused devastation to over 100 square miles (259 km²) of the planet's surface, killing millions of inhabitants instantly. It then blasted its way through the two planetary shield levels, pausing to exchange fire with an orbiting [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun]] before jettisoning the lift cradle and departing the Coruscant system. Later, New Republic scientists developed a cure for the Krytos virus by mixing [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] with a rare grade of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]], known as [[Ryll kor|kor]]. This prevented further loss of alien life, though inter-species relationships remained volatile for some time.<ref name="TKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

===New Republic===
====Center of the New Republic====
{{Quote|Welcome to the next chapter in the history of the galaxy.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Tyr Taskeen]] to [[Brenn Tantor|Brenn]] and [[Dellis Tantor]]|<ref name="FC">''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''</ref>}}
Controlling Coruscant was the key to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] for the New Republic. Imperial City was renamed once more to Galactic City and the former official name Imperial Center was abandoned. After Isard's loss of Coruscant and her retreat to Thyferra, fragmentation within the Empire deepened as the Imperials lost faith in their leaders and the survivors of the Imperial Inner Circle were found once again providing a tenuous central authority for the Empire. They supported the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] as Supreme Commander—mistakenly believing that as an alien, and with no standing in their rarefied political world, he would necessarily remain beholden to their patronage and government.<ref name="TTTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[File:RebelVictoryAtCoruscant.jpg|thumb|right|185px|New Republic troops hoisting the banner of the New Republic over Coruscant]]
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Coruscant was visited by the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] which surrounded the planet with a fleet of [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s, marking the first time in millennia that the insular society had made significant contact with the rest of the galaxy since the Consortium sealed its borders around [[3100 BBY]]. At the [[Grand Reception Hall]], the Hapan delegates presented the New Republic with many magnificent gifts including several captured [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

However, the final gift would be the most shocking of them all. The Hapan [[Queen Mother]]'s son and heir [[Isolder]] presented himself to Councilor [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] as a marriage suitor. Despite realizing the benefits of an arranged marriage between the two factions, she was still romantically attached to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Following an adventure on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|defeat]] of the Imperial warlord [[Zsinj]] at the hands of the Hapan fleet, Han Solo and Leia Organa married during a wedding ceremony at the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] consulate on Coruscant. This was attended by hundreds of friends and officials and viewed on [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] by billions across the galaxy.<ref name="TCoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], during the [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn Crisis]], Grand Admiral Thrawn's [[Thrawn's confederation|fleet]] [[Siege of Coruscant|besieged]] the galactic capital<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> on 44:8:11.<ref name="TEA" /> Since his forces were outnumbered by the New Republic defenses of Coruscant, he used [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking technology]] to create an effective siege weapon. To do this, he fitted 22 asteroids with cloaking devices and placed them onboard his Star Destroyers. During the battle, Thrawn placed the asteroids in low orbit, then retreated into hyperspace, creating an invisible hazard field around the galactic capital. As a result, the New Republic was faced with two major problems: they could not drop the energy shield around the planet in case an asteroid hit the heavily populated cityscape, nor could they allow space traffic near the planet in case of collision. This left Coruscant effectively blockaded. After Thrawn died at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]],<ref name="TLC" /> on 44:8:27,<ref name="TEA" /> the blockade was lifted and Coruscant was free again.<ref name="TLC" />

====Imperial resurgence and the Dark Empire====
{{Quote|It weighs on me like an unseen burden, Voren. To see this world, where I spent so much of my childhood, the capital world of the Republic, like ''this''... Deities help us, the sounds at night, the fires...|New Republic reporter Rivoche Tarkin during the Imperial infighting on Coruscant|<ref name="DES" />}}
[[File:ATATCoruscant.jpg|thumb|left|185px|Imperial factions turn on each other after retaking Coruscant.]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the Imperial Inner Circle, encouraged by what Thrawn had accomplished so quickly with so little, agreed to organize an [[Second Battle of Coruscant|attack]] on Coruscant and other key New Republic worlds in the Core. This forced [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to consider a last-minute plan for the defense of the galactic capital. However, she never got a chance since the combined Imperial armada began bombarding Coruscant's energy shield from orbit, causing extensive damage to the heavily populated cityscape below. Mon Mothma then ordered a general evacuation of the entire population of the capital. Thus, the Empire had retaken its Center and the New Republic resorted to guerrilla fighting.<ref name="DE">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref>

However, after Coruscant had been retaken, the Council decided that it was time to elect a new Galactic Emperor. The various admirals, [[General/Legends|generals]], [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] and [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] officials disagreed, and an [[Imperial Civil War|armed conflict]] soon broke out amongst the various Imperial factions on Coruscant.<ref name="DE" /> At the height of the infighting, the equivalent of three sector fleets divided among twelve factions annihilated each other in Coruscant's skies, while [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardments]] were ordered, terror troops destroyed reactors to weaken the planetary shields, and counter-insurgents fought openly in city streets and walkways.<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> The city planet was devastated during the conflict with much of the planet-wide metropolis devastated by the fighting and the deaths of billions. The space around Coruscant was littered with the wreckage of starships which would not be cleared for years. However, eventually the cloned Palpatine appeared, claiming that ''he'' was Emperor, and ended the Imperial Civil War. Later he decided to create a new empire, since the remnants of the Empire had claimed the galactic capital and recovered the old Galactic Empire, which he renamed the [[Dark Empire]].<ref name="DE" />

====Reconstruction and war's end====
After Palpatine's final death in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] at the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Onderon]], the New Republic retook the planet and used EVS Construction Droids to clear the rubble and create new, gleaming skyscrapers.<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> While Coruscant had suffered severe damage during the Imperial Civil War, the solar mirrors remained in their orbits and no irreversible damage had been done to the planet itself. Many urban centers remained mostly intact, and, most critically, the major water distribution systems were largely undamaged. New Republic civil and military forces received funding from the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]] to begin rebuilding the planet's infrastructure, particularly government facilities such as Imperial City and the Imperial Palace. Another priority was the clearing of hazardous debris drifting in orbit, which posed a danger to essential shipments of consumables. After several months of work, the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] had cleared safe zones through the debris, and shipping resumed a somewhat regular schedule. Most of the key Imperial City areas were largely restored, and within a year the metropolis had returned to its usual administrative and business activities.<ref name="TJAS" /> However, the shadowy lower levels remained unaffected by the reconstruction programmed and would still remain the haunt of various crime syndicates. Many still struggled to survive in the lower forty or fifty levels.

In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], following the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], while Leia Organa Solo was preparing for a speech, the Senate Building was attacked and severely damaged by [[Brakiss]] and [[Kueller|Dolph]], forcing a nearly complete renovation.<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>

[[File:Coruscant_Lev.jpg|thumb|280px|Coruscant in the New Republic era]]
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], following the signing of the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]] by Imperial Grand Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and New Republic Chief of State [[Ponc Gavrisom]] on the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']],<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] planned to wed on Coruscant. However, [[20 ABY/Legends|one year later]], during the [[Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade|wedding ceremony]], a group of Imperial partisans attempted to sabotage it including infiltrating the event site and hiring a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] to disrupt the wedding.<ref name="Union">''[[Star Wars: Union]]''</ref>

The wedding started with a bachelor party in the lower levels before attending a private Jedi ceremony in the renovated Jedi Temple. The public ceremony at Coruscant's [[Reflection Gardens]] remained largely peaceful because [[Booster Terrik]] and several others kept the swoop gang at bay. Lastly, when the final Imperial partisan attempted to unleash a computer virus, Luke persuaded him to surrender and to join the party.<ref name="Union" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], the [[Second Imperium]] infiltrated the Coruscant system by using the cloaked [[Shadow Academy]] to remain in orbit above the planet, invisible to the eyes of the New Republic military presence and [[Coruscant Planetary Defense Force]]. A Second Imperium force consisting of the former [[TIE pilot]] [[Qorl]]'s [[Imperial Assault Shuttle|assault shuttle]] and several modified [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] also boarded the [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] [[Adamant (bulk cruiser)|''Adamant'']] and fled into hyperspace with its valuable cargo of starship hyperdrives.<ref name="TLO">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref>

The Imperium also sent three [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] named [[Tamith Kai]], [[Garowyn]] and [[Vilas]] to infiltrate the lower levels and recruit more followers for their cause including the street gang [[Lost Ones]] and [[Zekk]]. Those discovered to be Force-sensitive became Dark Jedi while others became [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] and TIE pilots. However, Jedi trainees [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Tenel Ka Djo]] and [[Lowbacca]] used several solar mirrors to burn out the Shadow Academy's cloaking systems, exposing it to the New Republic fleet. The station powered its hyperdrive and escaped into hyperspace.<ref name="TLO" />

===Yuuzhan'tar===
{{Quote|You can see things have changed.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]]|<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>}}
Coruscant's darkest hour was at the peak of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. During the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Fall of Coruscant]], the extragalactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] overwhelmed the Republic defenses in three attack waves and conquered the planet. Coruscant, which had been completely covered in city sprawl for millennia, was devastated during the assault. Billions of lives were also lost during the battle.<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

[[File:BattleOfCoruscantYuuzhanVongWar-TheNJOSourcebook.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' attempts to rescue Borsk Fey'lya during the Fall of Coruscant in 27 ABY.]]
Many of the landmarks of Coruscant either met their end or were altered to suit the invaders' needs. The Imperial Palace was destroyed when Chief of State [[Borsk Fey'lya]] detonated a suicide bomb in his office; the Manarai Mountains, the last part of the planet untouched by cityscape, were blasted into giant craters; the Western Sea, the planet's sole body of water at the time, was turned into a giant [[Succession pool]]; the Senate Building became the location of the [[World Brain]], which was in charge of the terraforming of the planet. It was at this event the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|Yuuzhan Vong Empire]] was formed, since they had claimed the galactic capital.<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>

The Yuuzhan Vong designated it Yuuzhan'tar, after their ancient homeworld, and [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] it to overwhelm the city covering its surface and restore a natural ecology. In order to get Yuuzhan'tar to match their original homeworld, large [[dovin basal]]s pulled the planet closer to Coruscant Prime and biological processes were set forth to create the jungle including increasing the temperature and releasing more moisture into the atmosphere. Soon, nearly the entire planetwide city was covered beneath vegetation while rivers filled canyons where airspeeders had once roamed before. The lower levels were the domain of wildlife brought in from the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy]] and was where most of the outcast [[Shamed Ones]] lived.<ref name="Traitor" />

Coruscant's three smaller moons were dragged from their original orbits by dovin basals while its largest moon was destroyed by tidal stress created by pulses from other [[yammosk]]-linked dovin basals. A similar technique dragged the resulting expanse of dust, rock and hardening magma into a wide spreading asteroid belt known as the [[Rings of Coruscant|Rainbow Bridge]], that they were familiar with. The Rainbow Bridge orbited Coruscant around at an angle of 17 degrees from the ecliptic.<ref name="Traitor" />

The vast majority of the planet's non-Yuuzhan Vong population retreated into the planet's lower levels to avoid Yuuzhan Vong persecution. Millions of the citizens were sent into inhabited systems in [[camp ship]]s. During the occupation, the residents of the city called its substructure the "new" Coruscant '''[[Necropolis (slang)|Necropolis]]'''<ref name="Traitor" /> A resistance movement of shopkeepers-turned-guerrilla fighters also emerged in the bottom levels of the Petrax Historic Quarter.<ref name="CatCW" /> After the fall of their homeworld, many former residents of Coruscant fled to [[Galantos]], noting the lack of interest the Yuuzhan Vong showed in conquering the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]],<ref name="CatCW" /> where Galantos was located.<ref name="EAOC" />

When the living planet [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] suddenly arrived in the system, it collapsed the Rainbow Bridge, caused another of Coruscant's moons to be ejected from orbit, and pulled Coruscant closer to its original orbit, causing volcanic eruptions and [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] for the first time in two thousand years. The newly formed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] retook Coruscant from the Yuuzhan Vong during the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|Recapture of Coruscant]].<ref name="TUF" />

===Galactic Alliance===
{{Quote|Sometimes I think this planet is nothing but a hellhole.|Natasi Daala, to an unconscious [[Nek Bwua'tu]]|<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Legacy_Coruscant.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Coruscant during the reign of the Fel Empire]]
The Galactic Alliance and the Yuuzhan Vong signed a [[Sekot accords|peace treaty]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], thus ending the Yuuzhan Vong War, and not long after, terminated the Yuuzhan Vong Empire and the [[Peace Brigade]]. It was decided that Coruscant would be rebuilt as the capital of the Galactic Alliance, returning to the ecumenopolis-style whenever possible while leaving the Yuuzhan Vong terraforming wherever it was as yet unfeasible to change. The World Brain would still remain in the Senate Building, as there was as yet no way to remove it without causing further damage to the planet.

As the government transferred back to the world from [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] in [[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]], buildings such as the Senate Building were remodeled, new buildings were constructed such as the [[Defense Force Command Compound|Defense Force headquarters]] and the [[New Jedi Temple]]. With this move, the Galactic Alliance had officially taken authority of the galaxy. A large park called [[Unity Green]] was also constructed to symbolize the treaty between the Yuuzhan Vong and the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="TJK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

Coruscant began to appear as bustling and thriving as it once did during the Old Republic with the effects of the Yuuzhan Vong War still a reminder, from the growth on skyscrapers, to the altered night sky. Air traffic in skylanes was still the primary mode of transportation.<ref name="TJK" />

Around the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] (GAG), a secret police organization, was formed by the Galactic Alliance to spy on and monitor Corellian terrorist activity on Coruscant. The Guard was led by Jacen Solo, a Jedi Knight, a Colonel of the Galactic Alliance military, and also an aspiring Sith Lord.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

The GAG were responsible for interning and deporting Corellian citizens in Galactic City, and in some cases, executing those taken during the raids. Thus, because of these harsh actions and their dark military uniforms, members of the Guard earned a fast reputation as a uncompromising band of hard-liners among the population. Members of the Coruscant Security Force gave them the nickname "Stormies," thus drawing inevitable comparisons of Jacen Solo to the late Darth Vader and the troops themselves to stormtroopers.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

Under Solo's leadership the soldiers saw a likeness within Solo with Vader's own command style, noting that he "never asked of them what he would not do himself." Though necessary in some respects, the GAG's actions were mainly a vehicle for Solo's rise to the position of Sith Lord. This would only deepen the rift between the Galactic Alliance and the [[Confederation|Corellian-led secessionist movement]].<ref name="Bloodlines" />

In the same year, Solo, now the Sith Lord Darth Caedus, was attacked by [[Kyle Katarn]] and three other Jedi Knights in front of the Senate building. Katarn was deeply wounded and [[Thann Mithric|one of the Knights]] had lost his life by Caedus's hand, but Katarn and the other Jedi had managed to escape. The outcome came as expected for the Jedi.
